atagia_subtitle: Configure the system memory sidecar used for chat context
atagia_enable_help: -- Use Atagia as primary chat memory with Aurvek history fallback
platform_help: Used by Atagia to isolate Aurvek memory from other host apps. Default: aurvek.
character_help: Blank lets Aurvek use prompt:{{id}} per prompt/persona.
db_help: Used when transport is local or auto without an HTTP URL.
http_help: HTTP mode accepts IP literal hosts only for SSRF protection.
keep_key: Leave blank to keep the current saved key.
admin_key_help: Used only for Atagia admin operations like pausing, draining, and resuming background processing. Leave blank to keep the current saved key.
review_queue_help: Read-only Atagia review queue. These rows are memory candidates or user confirmations after ingestion, not failed history-sync messages. Approval/rejection needs Atagia's review API before Aurvek can safely mutate them.
reason_hint: Optional note for Atagia admin state
pause_help: Atagia keeps accepting Aurvek messages but does not enqueue new extraction work.
drain_help: Blocks new jobs, waits for queued work to finish, then leaves processing paused.
hard_help: Stops workers from claiming further Atagia jobs while in-flight work can finish.
resume_help: Restores normal Atagia background processing for memory extraction and updates.
manual_sync: Manual backfill only. Enabling Atagia does not start a sync automatically.
retry_help: Failed or pending messages are retried by running sync again.
url_help: URL must be an IP literal in private range (SSRF protection)
gransabio_enable_help: -- Route qualifying requests through the multi-model pipeline
score_help: Threshold score (0.0 - 10.0) for accepting generated content
verbose_help: Enable for debugging -- logs full pipeline traces to console
cost_help: Multiplier applied to estimated cost before deducting balance (1 - 10)
enter_url: Enter the GranSabio URL before testing.
system_subtitle: Global prompt blocks injected into all AI conversations
name: Name
created_message: New prompt block "{name}" has been created.
disable_watchdog_help: Disabling this block may reduce watchdog directive effectiveness. The watchdog will still inject hints but without the authority preamble.
delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
reset_confirm: This will restore "{name}" to its default content and re-enable it. Any custom edits will be lost.
clear_notice: This saved key will be cleared when you save.
no_service_key: No saved service key. Enter a key only when using HTTP transport.
no_admin_key: No saved admin key. Enter a key only when using HTTP processing controls.
restore_atagia_confirm: Restore Atagia settings to environment/default values? Saved Atagia overrides will be removed.
sync_running: Atagia history sync is already running.
hard_confirm: Hard pause stops Atagia workers from claiming new jobs. Continue?
control_unavailable: Atagia processing control is not available.
engine_error: The engine could not complete this operation. Check the server logs for details.
request_failed: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
timeout_range: timeout_seconds must be greater than 0 and at most 300.
invalid_config: Invalid configuration. Check the transport, URL and timeout settings.
invalid_url: Invalid URL. Use http:// or https:// with an allowed IP address; public IPs require https://.
invalid_ips: Invalid allowed IPs. Use comma-separated /32 IPv4 or /128 IPv6 host addresses.
enable_invalid: Configuration invalid: {error}. Fix before enabling GranSabio.
enable_validation_failed: Cannot validate configuration. Check the server logs and fix before enabling GranSabio.
validation_warning: Configuration saved, but validation warning: {error}. Prompts using admin defaults may fail at runtime.
reserved_key: Cannot use a reserved system key
invalid_position: Invalid position. Must be one of: {values}
invalid_condition: Invalid condition. Must be one of: {values}
system_empty: System blocks cannot have empty content
reset_system_only: Only system blocks can be reset
no_default: No default found for this system block
local_diagnostics: System-wide diagnostics are available for local SQLite transport.
db_missing: Atagia SQLite database was not found.
invalid_transport: Invalid Atagia transport. Choose auto, local or http.
http_url_required: Base URL is required for HTTP transport.
